title: Gold Bar XL Watermelon Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Watermelon Ice captures the fresh, delicately sweet taste of Watermelon with a cool Menthol exhale that enhances It's clean, fruity flavour. It's an easygoing yet refreshing option that works well as an all-day vape. Each refill kit includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill reservoir, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for smooth, satisfying MTL vaping. Designed to work seamlessly with the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, this all-in-one refill unit combines simplicity with flavour performance. Each pod is fitted with a mesh coil for improved vapour consistency and reliable flavour throughout. Once the pod and reservoir are finished, the entire unit can be replaced with another flavour from the Gold Bar XL range.
